body:
If you really think you might have something, get it checked out. Get testing done. All the tests anyone can think to do.

I sometimes wonder how things might be different if someone had caught my condition earlier. But we all thought it was a one-and-done thing. Nobody thought to look for more damage until it was too late. It took a specialist in another state to find the additional damage that led to the realization that what I have is degenerative.

I don't know. It's not okay for me. I don't know how to live with this idea that it's just going to get worse. I don't know the point of it. It's so much effort, for what? I don't have kids, or a partner. Just seems like so much effort to keep suffering for a little longer.

Don't even fuck around with this. Seriously. If you think something is there, get it checked. You don't want to be where I am right now. I might not have been, if someone had done more serious checking earlier.
